import sys
from collections import Counter

def solve() -> None:
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    A, B, C, D = map(int, data[:4])
    cnt = Counter([A, B, C, D])
    freq = sorted(cnt.values())
    # Cases:
    # 1) [1,3] -> add to the single
    # 2) [2,2] -> add to either of the pair
    if freq == [1, 3] or freq == [2, 2]:
        print("Yes")
    else:
        print("No")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
